newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: FPHC sees 96/97 net at 760 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: FPHC sees 96/97 net at 760 mln pesos.

text.p: First Philipine Holdings Corp (FPHC) said on Friday it expects a recurring net income of 760 million pesos for its 1996-1997 fiscal year ending June 30.
FPHC president Elpidio Ibanez told reporters after a special stockholders meeting that revenues are projected to reach 1.7 billion pesos to 1.8 billion for the year.
Ibanez said that the bulk of the company's revenue, or about 900 million pesos, will come from its subsidiaries.
FPHC is the single biggest shareholder in Manila Electric Co (Meralco), the country's largest electricity distributor. FPHC also has interests in oil exploration, real estate and infrastructure.
FPHC stockholders approved an amendment to the company's articles of incorportion allowing the firm to raise up to $300 million to fund its power and infrastructure projects.
